piece.headline: ARORA HAS A SHOCKER, LEAD STILL GROWS
piece.standfirst: The league's captain blanked again. Aditya took the week, and Arora's lead still grew.
piece.big_picture: 92 of 113 managers captained Haaland. He scored 2, so 4 each with the armband. The best of the 21 who went elsewhere: Aryan Apte with Silva, 16 with the armband. Manager of the Week: Aditya (56 pts). 19 above the league average of 37.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Krishna left 26 points on the bench, the biggest waste in the league. Gentle advice: the team sheet deserves another look.
piece.one_to_watch: Karan Singh and Kshiteesh are split by 1 point for the last Top prizes place. One good captain pick could decide it. If Haaland returns, both might lean on him.

winners.name: Sandeepan
winners.verdict: Tavernier in, and Sandeepan jumped from 63rd to 43rd. A bold swap that paid off.

winners.name: Nihal
winners.verdict: Bench Boost paid 11 points. Kinsky arrived and the table kept shifting his way. Nerve, and a bit of luck.

losers.name: Monty
losers.verdict: Mbeumo and N.Jackson cost a 4-point hit. The week's lowest score was the return. Hits should buy points, not pain.

losers.name: Mayuresh
losers.verdict: Mayuresh has dropped every week for a month, from 8th to 48th. Free Fall is the right name. Nobody can call this a blip any more.
